screen.rationale: Primary study; 415 nm light generates Cl radicals from chlorinated solvents that cut PP (Mn before/after by HT-GPC in text) and release HCl that depolymerizes PET to terephthalic acid (isolated yields in text). Light step required (dark control Mn 30.8 vs 14.7 kDa; no TPA without light).
